Woman killed, newlywed couple critical as fire engulfs West Delhi home; neighbours break window to rescue family
results.content: With the main entrance blocked, residents smashed a window to pull out three trapped family members from the smoke-filled first floor in Raghubir Nagar; the couple, married barely two months ago, suffered 20% and 60% burns respectively.
